positive.prompt: Create a GitLab MR from current branch with our standardized description template
Format and publish this branch as a GitLab merge request with standard MR preview
Prepare a review-ready GitLab MR description with test evidence and validation scenarios

negative.prompt: Use glab to inspect this GitLab pipeline, then retry the failed deployment job if I approve
Split the current working tree into a clean series of atomic commits

evals.prompt: Create a GitLab merge request for this branch using glab. Format the description using our standard MR template.
evals.expected_output: An MR preview showing title, target branch, standardized description with Lane, Touchpoints, Test Evidence, and command, asking for explicit user confirmation before running glab mr create.
expectations: The agent drafts a standardized MR description containing Summary, Context & Lane, and Test Evidence
The agent presents an MR preview with the exact glab mr create command before creating the MR
The agent asks for explicit user confirmation before executing the MR creation command
No raw secrets or unredacted tokens are included in the description
